description: Result of POST /iam/orgs/{orgId}/auth-provider/test. The test never persists side effects.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic. For OIDC: the discovery + token-exchange result. For LDAP: the bind result.
message.example: OIDC discovery succeeded; JWKS published at /jwks; token exchange simulated.

latencyMs.description: Round-trip latency in milliseconds. Null when the test failed before a request was issued.

details.description: Provider-specific diagnostics (discovery URL, JWKS URL, bind subject, ...). Free-form.
